entities.name: Miguel de la Torre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel de la Torre y Pando, 1st Count of Torre-Pando was a Spanish general, governor and captain general, who served in Spain, Venezuela, Colombia and Puerto Rico during the Spanish American wars of independence and afterwards.
